title: Keto Snack Plate for Two
seo_title: Keto Snack Plate for Two: A Grazing Dinner Shopping List
description: A keto snack plate for two that's dinner: brie, aged cheddar, prosciutto, salami, cucumbers, radishes, Kalamata olives, macadamia nuts and raspberries.
hook: A grazing plate that is the meal: a keto dinner for two you assemble instead of cook.
why: This plate is portioned as dinner for two, so it's more generous than a starter board: creamy brie and aged cheddar, prosciutto and salami, with macadamia nuts for richness.

Radishes and cucumbers stand in for crackers and add a peppery, fresh crunch, Kalamata olives add salt and raspberries add a little sweetness. Flaky salt and black pepper on the vegetables make them taste like a side dish.

timeline.what: Take the cheddar out of the fridge.
Take out the prosciutto and salami. Slice the cucumber and radishes.
Finish the radishes with flaky salt. Serve.

faq.q: What's a good keto dinner plate?
faq.a: A soft cheese and a hard one, two cured meats, crunchy vegetables like radishes and cucumber, olives, macadamia nuts and a few berries.
About 9 g net carbs per serving.
About 10 to 15 minutes to slice and arrange.
